sets.title: Pick the Right Word
sets.description: Choose the correct impersonal expression or case form
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное безличное выражение или форму падежа

items.prompt: _____ жарко. Откройте окно. (I'm hot. Open the window.)
items.explanation: Impersonal: мне жарко (dative). No nominative subject.

items.prompt: Здесь _____ фотографировать. (You can't take photos here.)
items.explanation: Нельзя фотографировать = photography is not allowed.

items.prompt: _____ нужно уйти пораньше. (She needs to leave early.)

items.explanation: Можно + infinitive for permission: Можно войти?

items.prompt: _____ скучно на этом уроке. (We're bored in this class.)
items.explanation: Нам скучно: impersonal with dative plural.

items.prompt: Тебе _____ больше отдыхать. (You need to rest more.)
items.explanation: Тебе надо + infinitive: you need to rest more.

items.prompt: _____ стыдно за своё поведение. (He's ashamed of his behavior.)
items.hint: Emotional state: dative + adverb. He = ему (dative).
items.explanation: Ему стыдно: impersonal emotional state with dative.

minimalPairs.explanation: Prohibition: нельзя курить = smoking is forbidden here.

minimalPairs.context: _____ я возьму эту книгу? (asking the librarian)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: May I take this book? (asking permission)
minimalPairs.explanation: Asking permission: Можно + 1st person future = May I?

minimalPairs.context: Мне _____ на этой лекции. (The topic is fascinating.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Positive reaction: мне интересно = I find it interesting.

minimalPairs.context: Мне _____ на этой лекции. (The topic is dull.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Negative reaction: мне скучно = I'm bored.

sets.title: Transform and Translate
sets.description: Rewrite personal sentences as impersonal and translate
sets.descriptionRussian: Перестройте личные предложения в безличные и переведите

translation.explanation: Physical state: мне холодно. No subject, no verb 'to be.'

translation.prompt: Is it possible to park here?

translation.explanation: Emotional state: детям весело (impersonal, dative + adverb).

blanks: _____ плохо. Вызовите врача! (He feels sick. Call a doctor!)
Здесь _____ громко разговаривать. (You can't talk loudly here.)
_____ нужно купить продукты. (We need to buy groceries.)
hints: He = ему (dative). Physical state: dative + плохо.
explanations: Ему плохо: dative + adverb for physical state.
Нельзя + infinitive: it is not allowed to talk loudly.
Нам нужно: dative + нужно + infinitive for necessity.

errorCorrection.hint: Physical state needs dative, not nominative.

errorCorrection.explanation: Ей нужно идти (dative). Она is nominative and wrong here.

errorCorrection.hint: If it means 'you must not make noise,' that's prohibition.
errorCorrection.explanation: Prohibition: нельзя шуметь. Можно не = it's OK not to (optional), which is different.

errorCorrection.hint: Before infinitive, нужно is always neuter (нужно), not feminine.
errorCorrection.explanation: Нужно + infinitive is fixed neuter. Нужна agrees with a feminine noun (мне нужна книга).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All impersonal construction types mixed together

items.prompt: _____ страшно в темноте. (The child is scared in the dark.)
items.promptEnglish: The child is scared in the dark.
items.hint: Emotional state: dative + adverb. Child = ребёнку (dative).
items.explanation: Ребёнку страшно: dative + adverb for emotional state.

items.prompt: _____ нельзя опаздывать на работу. (One must not be late for work.)
items.promptEnglish: Being late for work is not acceptable.
items.hint: General prohibition (for everyone) = нельзя without dative.
items.explanation: General rule: нельзя опаздывать. No dative = applies to everyone.

items.promptEnglish: They have a good time together.
items.hint: Emotional state: dative + adverb. They = им (dative).
Impersonal = no nominative subject, dative experiencer.
items.explanation: Ему плохо: dative + adverb, no nominative subject. The others all have он (nominative) as subject.

items.prompt: _____ надо выучить эти слова к завтрашнему уроку. (They need to learn these words by tomorrow's class.)
items.promptEnglish: They need to learn these words for tomorrow's lesson.

items.prompt: В самолёте _____ пользоваться телефоном. (You can't use your phone on the plane.)
items.promptEnglish: Using phones on the plane is prohibited.
items.explanation: Нельзя пользоваться телефоном: prohibition (not allowed by regulations).

patternRecognition.sentence: Нельзя здесь парковаться. / Не нужно здесь парковаться.
patternRecognition.question: What is the difference between these two sentences?
options: First = it's forbidden (you can't); second = it's not necessary (you don't need to)
patternRecognition.answer: First = it's forbidden (you can't); second = it's not necessary (you don't need to)
patternRecognition.explanation: Нельзя = prohibition (forbidden). Не нужно = not necessary (but you could if you wanted).

patternRecognition.sentence: Мне нужна книга. / Мне нужно читать.
patternRecognition.question: Why is it нужна in the first but нужно in the second?
options: Нужна agrees with книга (feminine); нужно is fixed neuter before infinitives
Нужна is formal, нужно is informal
patternRecognition.answer: Нужна agrees with книга (feminine); нужно is fixed neuter before infinitives
patternRecognition.explanation: Before a noun, нужен/нужна/нужно/нужны agrees in gender/number. Before an infinitive, it's always нужно (neuter).

blanks: _____ трудно говорить по-русски? (Is it hard for you to speak Russian?)
Студентам _____ сдать экзамен до июня. (Students need to pass the exam before June.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Dative experiencer with state adverbs vs necessity
explanations: Студентам нужно: necessity (dative plural + нужно + infinitive).
